chapter: Reading bands, brass bands and Fate Marable
title: Manuel Perez's insistence on reading and varied repertoire
summary: Perez's Onward and roof garden bands read music, and Perez disliked improvised hot choruses and refused to repeat numbers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Did everybody read in the Onward?
In the Onward Brass Band? Mm-hmm. Oh, what? Yes, indeed. That fine band, man. Yes, indeed.
You couldn't get in there unless you...
Oh, no. Oh, no. Oh, no.
Well, how many of them faked? Could they...

Almost all of them could play. Oh, yeah. Mm-hmm. But Manny didn't like it. He was a fellow that didn't like that playing by air. He didn't like it. Uh-uh. He wouldn't let Maurice get off and take hot choruses. No, he didn't care for that. He didn't like that. And Maurice said, play what you see. He used to make Maurice so angry. You just play what's on that paper. Maurice would get mad. We all would get mad because Maurice is a nice trumpet player, you know. He could get off, you know. But Manny would let it. And he didn't believe in sitting up there playing the same numbers every night. He would want to change his repertoire. Joe would just send him music, man. See, like your music piled up there, over there. See these books? About every month, Joe Allen would send him a stack of music like that. Yeah, send me. He would say, every month. And he just kept playing the numbers. He never would play the same number three times for nothing in the world. You couldn't get any. Don't care how nice the number was. He didn't play. See, we was playing on the roof garden four nights a week, you see, on the top of the roof garden. And he said he don't leave sitting on the job playing the same music every night. It was different. That's right. That was his idea. Nobody couldn't change it.
Well, I'd say comparing a band like Perez's band with Foster's brass band. Foster's brass band.
Man, you ought not even to talk about that.
Would Foster have any regular men or anything? No, just pick up men.

Pick up guys, yeah. I ain't never heard of this brass band play. They say he had brass band go out there and play fields and parades and whatever. Me and Caffrey was the only one on the roof garden that didn't read in the band. Caffrey and I, the only one. He played some fine music. You know he had to teach to play potent peasant? But he had to rehearse for that with me and Caffrey, you know, see, different movements. Mm-hmm.
Boy, he passed me a shit day. Fine music. And Jimmy Johnson, Red Bass Music. I mean Caffrey was the only one that didn't read. But the people didn't know it, because we played so well.
